def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate an 8-bit value left by k bits, wrapping high bits around."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    ex rotl8(wrap_as[uint8](1), 0) == wrap_as[uint8](1)
    ex rotl8(wrap_as[uint8](128), 1) == wrap_as[uint8](1)
    ex rotl8(wrap_as[uint8](129), 1) == wrap_as[uint8](3)
    return bits.rotate_left(x, k)
